name: @keys-i/seer
description: Build-time localization, JSON content, SEO, and AI-search metadata for any website.
author: keys-i

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && npm run action:build
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test/*.test.js test/*.test.mjs
scripts.coverage: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=dist/src/*.js --test-coverage-include=demo/path.mjs --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 --test-coverage-branches=90 dist/test/*.test.js test/*.test.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run coverage && node dist/test/seer.bench.js && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs && node demo/build.mjs && node -e "const{execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const s=execFileSync('git',['status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all','--ignored=matching','--','docs','actions/locale.mjs'],{encoding:'utf8'});if(s){console.error(s);process.exit(1)}" && npm audit
